content.text:
I finished the quest. I lifted the Eye of Argonia, so the trees are now parted for good.

- **Cost:** About three in ten trees died, and the people of Jal-Veesa and Teel-Fen Weir left. The dreams ended and the order is broken.
- **Standing:** The Unbound are friendly and call me Knot-Breaker. The Toh-Reel-Ka are hostile and will hunt me, and no Hist will bless me again.
- **Fort Chalkmoth:** The game says the Unbound broke open the cellar door. I never went there, so I still haven't checked whether Cuts-the-Old-Knot was telling the truth about the dreamers.
- **Oddity:** Cuts-the-Old-Knot was standing at the Root even though I thought I had killed him. He refused to talk to me.
- **Gained:** The spell The Eye's Gaze, and I kept the Eye.
- **Still open:** The Fort Chalkmoth key and cellar, and Ennodius Vanin the Collector. I did not loot the hydra's treasure.

I gave the game my final notes and it closed.
